# Wayground

> > Wayground (formerly Quizizz) is a teacher AI platform providing educational resources, curriculum adaptation tools, and classroom assessment solutions with LMS integration.

Wayground offers differentiated learning experiences, student accommodations, and mastery-based assessment modes. The platform supports educators like Janelle Snyder, Marcus Sanders, and Shaunna Young with AI-powered tools for curriculum adaptation and grading across Windows, Android, and iOS devices.

## Key Topics

- Teacher AI Platform
- Quizizz (former brand)
- Curriculum Adaptation
- Student Differentiation
- Classroom Assessments
- LMS Integration
- Mastery Peak Mode
- Student Accommodations
- LAB-AIDS Science Curriculum
- Grading Reports
- Session Management
- Accessibility (VPAT)
- Subscription Plans
- Education Technology
